title: IpcFrameHeader::decode is total over [u8;24]
description: Prove that IpcFrameHeader::decode returns Result<Self, IpcError> for all 2^192 possible 24-byte inputs without panicking
behavior_impact: Critical: any panic in decode would be an uncaught exception at the IPC boundary

title: InvalidMagic checked before UnsupportedVersion
description: Prove that for any bytes where magic != IPC_MAGIC, decode returns InvalidMagic and never UnsupportedVersion or any later error
behavior_impact: Critical: magic must be the first gate to prevent protocol confusion

title: UnsupportedVersion checked before UnknownCommand
description: Prove that decode returns UnsupportedVersion only when magic == IPC_MAGIC and version != IPC_VERSION, never when command is also invalid
behavior_impact: High: wrong version should be detected before command validation

title: UnknownCommand checked before ReservedNonZero
description: Prove that ReservedNonZero is returned only when magic, version, and command are all valid
behavior_impact: High: reserved field must not be checked before command is validated

title: PayloadTooLarge checked after all structural fields
description: Prove that PayloadTooLarge is returned only when magic, version, command, and reserved are all valid AND payload_len > max
behavior_impact: Critical: oversize payload must never be accepted after structural fields are valid

title: ReservedNonZero returns before PayloadTooLarge
description: Prove that for any bytes where reserved != 0, ReservedNonZero is returned even if payload_len > max
behavior_impact: Critical: protocol compliance checked before allocation bounds

title: payload_len u32→usize overflow returns PayloadLengthOutOfRange
description: Prove that when u32 payload_len cannot fit in usize, PayloadLengthOutOfRange is returned before PayloadTooLarge
behavior_impact: High: 32-bit target overflow must be caught before bounds comparison

title: decode_frame_payload fails if actual_len != header.payload_len
description: Prove that decode_frame_payload returns PayloadLengthMismatch when payload.len() != header.payload_len
behavior_impact: Critical: frame integrity depends on declared vs actual payload length match

title: encode_frame produces roundtrip-identical header
description: Prove that for any valid IpcFrameHeader h, encode().and_then(decode) == Ok(h)
behavior_impact: High: encode/decode must be perfect inverses for all valid headers

title: BoundedPayload::new rejects oversized payload
description: Prove BoundedPayload::new returns PayloadTooLarge when payload.len() > max.get()
behavior_impact: Critical: no payload can exceed its declared bound

title: MaxPayloadBytes::DEFAULT is exactly 1 MiB
description: Prove MaxPayloadBytes::DEFAULT.get() == 1_048_576
behavior_impact: Critical: protocol constant, cannot change without version bump

title: handle_readable reads at most READ_CHUNK_BYTES per poll
description: Prove that handle_readable appends at most READ_CHUNK_BYTES (4096) bytes to read_buffer per invocation
behavior_impact: Critical: prevents unbounded buffer growth per poll event

title: partial header never triggers Vec::with_capacity(payload_len)
description: Prove that server never allocates a Vec sized by header.payload_len before header decode succeeds
behavior_impact: Critical: the core oversize protection depends on this

title: oversize header causes disconnect without reading payload
description: Prove that when IpcFrameHeader::decode returns PayloadTooLarge, server disconnects client without reading any payload bytes from socket
behavior_impact: Critical: oversize frame must not cause payload bytes to be read

title: frame not dispatched until read_buffer has complete frame
description: Prove that dispatch_command_with_resolver is called only when read_buffer.len() >= frame_total_len(header)
behavior_impact: Critical: incomplete frames must never be dispatched

title: IPC_MAGIC is exactly 0x5642_4C54 (VBLT in LE)
description: Prove IPC_MAGIC.to_le_bytes() == [0x54, 0x4C, 0x42, 0x56]
behavior_impact: Critical: protocol magic, first line of defense

title: IPC_MAGIC != 0 and IPC_MAGIC != 0xFFFF_FFFF
description: Prove IPC_MAGIC is non-zero and not all-ones (anti-spoofing)
behavior_impact: High: magic 0 and magic all-ones are rejected

title: IPC_VERSION is exactly 1
description: Prove IPC_VERSION == 1
behavior_impact: Critical: protocol version, rejected if not 1

title: decode rejects version != 1 regardless of command validity
description: Prove UnsupportedVersion is returned for version=0 and version=2 even if command is valid
behavior_impact: High: version is checked before command processing

title: IpcCommand::from_u16 accepts only 1..16
description: Prove from_u16 returns Ok only for values 1 through 16 inclusive
behavior_impact: High: no other command IDs are valid

title: IpcCommand::as_u16 and from_u16 are inverses for 1..16
description: Prove for all cmd in 1..16: IpcCommand::from_u16(cmd.as_u16()) == Ok(cmd)
behavior_impact: Medium: wire format roundtrip for command IDs

title: IPC_HEADER_LEN is exactly 24
description: Prove IPC_HEADER_LEN == 24 by wire layout sum (4+2+2+2+2+8+4)
behavior_impact: Critical: fixed header size, all parsing depends on this

title: encode_frame produces frame of exact length IPC_HEADER_LEN + payload.len()
description: Prove encode_frame returns frame where frame.len() == IPC_HEADER_LEN + payload.len() and frame[IPC_HEADER_LEN..] == payload
behavior_impact: High: frame format integrity

title: validate_frame_magic checks magic before any allocation
description: Prove validate_frame_magic returns HeaderDecodeFailed for <4 bytes and InvalidMagic for wrong magic without allocating
behavior_impact: High: magic check is zero-allocation

title: read_frame_payload reads exactly payload_len bytes
description: Prove read_frame_payload returns Err(PayloadDecodeFailed) when reader.read_exact fails (fewer than payload_len bytes available)
behavior_impact: Critical: declared payload length must match actual bytes

title: server with partial header stays in WaitingHeader state
description: Prove that when read_buffer.len() < IPC_HEADER_LEN, no header decode is attempted and no error is returned
behavior_impact: High: partial frames must not cause errors until complete

title: server with partial payload waits without allocating
description: Prove that when header is decoded but read_buffer.len() < frame_total_len, no payload allocation is attempted
behavior_impact: High: partial payload must not trigger Vec::with_capacity

title: error response uses Health command in header
description: Prove that frame_error_response creates response with command=Health, correlation=0, payload_len=0 and error message in payload
behavior_impact: Medium: error responses use fallback header
